changes.from: Skeleton official_url (support.fftai.com/en/docs/.../GR-1_Introduction/) now 404s. Values from Fourier's own GR-1 brochure PDF (Feb 2024, fftai branding; hosted on edit.site CDN): standing size 1650 x 515 x 320 mm, ~55 kg (Pro ~60 kg), 5 km/h (=1.39 m/s), 3 kg single-hand payload, 44 actuators (GR-1, dexterous hands; GR-1L 34), 460 Wh battery, i7-13700H compute, RealSense depth camera, IMU, ring mic, 230 N·m peak torque. DoF conflict: brochure text says 'up to 54 DoF' (with 11-DoF hands) vs 44 elsewhere - used 44 (spec-table actuator count). Unveiled 2023; since succeeded by GR-2/GR-3. SDK (Python/C++) offered.
